name: @mewvis/story
description: Mewvis 内置故事工坊：结构化小说项目、文档编辑、创作助手与章节酒馆。

scripts.dev: pnpm generate:skills && pnpm check:registry && mewvis-app dev
scripts.build: pnpm generate:skills && pnpm check:registry && mewvis-app build
scripts.check: pnpm generate:skills && pnpm check:registry && mewvis-app check
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test test/*.test.mjs && node test/core-e2e.mjs && node test/contract-e2e.mjs && node test/commit-tool-e2e.mjs && node test/tavern-agent-protocol-e2e.mjs && node test/boundary.mjs && node test/binding.mjs
